items.title: Jimmy Cobb — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Yeah, I knew Elmo. Not that much... The bass player, yeah. We played, Bertha, Ron McClure, and myself played a couple – two or three tunes.

ctx.x: Elmo, yeah. That’s Bertha’s husband. Yeah, I knew Elmo. Not that much, because back then they was into some stuff that I wasn’t going to be around.
I mean, did you know him musically?
